**Direct answer:** Black Condor II (Ryan Kendall) died in *Infinite Crisis* #1 (December 2005).

**Claims and sources**

- Ryan Kendall, the second Black Condor, was killed in *Infinite Crisis* #1.
  https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black_Condor

- He was with the Freedom Fighters when the Secret Society of Super Villains ambushed them, and Sinestro killed him.
  https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black_Condor

- The issue is dated December 2005. A search summary of the DC Fandom and DCU Guide pages gave this date. I didn't open those pages, because the DC Fandom page returned an error.
  https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Ryan_Kendall_(New_Earth)
  https://dcuguide.com/Black_Condor_(Ryan_Kendall)

- He later appeared as a Black Lantern during *Blackest Night*. The same search summary said a Prime Earth version was resurrected in *Dark Nights: Death Metal* #5. The Wikipedia page I read doesn't explain this. It only lists the Black Lantern Corps in his infobox. Treat this claim as less certain.
  https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Ryan_Kendall_(Prime_Earth)

Wikipedia and the search summaries agree on the death issue and the killer.
